def left_rotate(n: int, d: int) -> int:
    """Rotate the lower 32 bits of n to the left by d positions."""
    # Ensure we only consider the lowest 32 bits and handle negative shifts if needed
    mask = (1 << 32) - 1          # keep only 32 bits
    n &= mask                     # ensure n is treated as unsigned 32-bit
    
    d %= 32                       # normalize shift amount to [0, 31]
    
    left_part = (n << d) & mask   # shifted left part
    right_part = (n >> (32 - d)) & mask  # wrapped-around bits from the top
    
    return left_part | right_part


# Example test:
if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert left_rotate(16, 2) == 64
    print(left_rotate(16, 2))  # prints 64

def left_rotate(n: int, d: int) -> int:
    """Rotate the lower 32 bits of n to the left by d positions."""
    # Ensure we only consider the lowest 32 bits and handle negative shifts if needed
    mask = (1 << 32) - 1          # keep only 32 bits
    n &= mask                     # ensure n is treated as unsigned 32-bit
    
    d %= 32                       # normalize shift amount to [0, 31]
    
    left_part = (n << d) & mask   # shifted left part
    right_part = (n >> (32 - d)) & mask  # wrapped-around bits from the top
    
    return left_part | right_part


# Example test:
assert left_rotate(16, 2) == 64
print(left_rotate(16, 2))  # prints 64
